title: Bone Tea
description: At the start of the next combat, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] your starting hand.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Starts with 1 combat remaining. Upgrades all cards in the player's starting hand at the beginning of the player's first turn in each combat, then decrements the counter. Becomes disabled when the counter reaches 0.
